notes:
Account summary: Conversio Labs is a mid-market SaaS company (B2B customer support automation) evaluating Redwood for chat/agent workloads. They initially onboarded on an incumbent LLM API but have experienced latency regressions over the last 4–6 weeks that materially impact streaming UX and tool-calling flows. CTO quote: "We started seeing tail latency spikes and partial stream stalls after the vendor's January rollout. It breaks our agent UI."

POC plan / commercial motion:
- Running Hosted API POC first (2-week streaming and tool-calling benchmark across typical customer flows).
- If Hosted POC meets SLOs and pricing targets, migration to Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable throughput and data isolation (commit conversation ongoing).
- Trial metrics: E2E 99th pct <300ms target for typical turns; average <150ms; sustained throughput ~120 reqs/s for peak customer routing.

Technical notes & benchmarks so far:
- Benchmarked Redwood streaming vs incumbent (internal harness + Fireflies demo capture): Redwood consistently showed lower first-byte latency (median ~50ms less) and 99th percentile improvement ~40-60ms depending on prompt length.
- Tool calling: Redwood streaming + function call pipeline reduced end-to-end time in our tests (fewer stream reconnects, smoother content-chunking).
- Incumbent exhibited intermittent 1–3s stalls on long multi-tool interactions; reproducible in staged test.
